entries.title: Random hostile encounter: Enraged Boar
entries.text:
A Enraged Boar burst from cover at the Trampled Orchard and lunge for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
Goal: Defeat or drive off the Enraged Boar.

log: Opening attack.
You use Greatsword: d20 [12] (normal) + 3 Strength + 2 proficiency = 17 vs AC 11. Hit.
7 slashing damage (3 + 1 +3).
Your initiative: d20 [4] + 1 = 5.
Enraged Boar initiative: d20 10 + 0 = 10.
Turn order: Enraged Boar → You.
Round 1 begins.
Enraged Boar: d20 [7] (normal) +3 = 10 vs your AC 16. Miss.
Your turn.
A Enraged Boar burst from cover at the Trampled Orchard and lunge for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.

story.title: Random hostile encounter: Enraged Boar
story.premise: A combat test: a Enraged Boar ambushes Kara Vell at the Trampled Orchard while travelling with a small caravan.
story.opening: A Enraged Boar burst from cover at the Trampled Orchard and lunge for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
story.objective: Defeat or drive off the Enraged Boar.
story.resolution: Every attacker is defeated, or the player escapes and regroups at the caravan camp.
story.secret: There is no hidden twist; this is a straightforward combat test encounter.
story.foeAppearance: A massive bristle-backed boar with curved, chipped tusks, a torn ear and a broken arrow shaft lodged in its flank. It paws furrows into the earth.

inn.name: Caravan Camp
inn.description: A ring of covered wagons around a smoky campfire, a short walk back along the road.

bridge.name: Trampled Orchard
bridge.description: An abandoned orchard of gnarled apple trees, the ground torn up by heavy hooves.

tower.name: Lookout Rock
tower.description: A lichen-covered boulder above the road with a clear view of the surrounding country.

keeper.name: Captain Oona Brask
keeper.role: Caravan guard captain who hired the player as an escort.
keeper.motive: Get the wagons through safely and pay out only for honest work.
keeper.appearance: A stocky middle-aged dwarf woman with a braided copper beard ring, weathered tan skin, a dented steel cap and a green caravan tabard over chain mail. A ledger hangs from her belt.
keeper.personality: Blunt, dry-humoured and practical; speaks in short clipped sentences.

ties.note: Took Tobin on as a favour to his late mother and quietly looks out for him.

mara.name: Tobin Reed
mara.motive: Prove himself useful to the captain without getting anyone hurt.
mara.appearance: A slight young halfling man with unruly sandy hair, freckles, a patched brown cloak, a sling at his hip and a wooden spoon tucked behind one ear.
mara.personality: Eager, talkative and a little nervous; jokes when frightened.

ties.note: Idolises the captain, who gave him his first real job.

entries.title: Random hostile encounter: Bandit Cutthroat
entries.text:
A Bandit Cutthroat burst from cover at the Overgrown Roadside and lunge for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
Goal: Defeat or drive off the Bandit Cutthroat.

log: Opening attack.
You use Greatsword: d20 [8] (normal) + 3 Strength + 2 proficiency = 13 vs AC 12. Hit.
8 slashing damage (3 + 2 +3).
Your initiative: d20 [16] + 2 = 18.
Bandit Cutthroat initiative: d20 3 + 1 = 4.
Turn order: You → Bandit Cutthroat.
Round 1 begins.
Your turn.

story.premise: A combat test: a Bandit Cutthroat ambushes Vey Nightmere at the Overgrown Roadside while travelling with a small caravan.
story.opening: A Bandit Cutthroat burst from cover at the Overgrown Roadside and lunge for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.

story.resolution: Every attacker is defeated, or the player escapes and regroups at the caravan camp.

story.foeAppearance: A lean human bandit in a patched leather jerkin and a mud-stained hood, a notched scimitar in one hand and a knife in the other. A scarf covers the lower face; a crude tattoo of a crow marks one wrist.

inn.name: Caravan Camp
inn.description: A ring of covered wagons around a smoky campfire, a short walk back along the road.

bridge.name: Overgrown Roadside
bridge.description: A rutted forest road narrowed by brambles, where a toppled cart blocks the way.

tower.name: Lookout Rock
tower.description: A lichen-covered boulder above the road with a clear view of the surrounding country.

keeper.name: Captain Oona Brask
keeper.role: Caravan guard captain who hired the player as an escort.
keeper.motive: Get the wagons through safely and pay out only for honest work.
keeper.appearance: A stocky middle-aged dwarf woman with a braided copper beard ring, weathered tan skin, a dented steel cap and a green caravan tabard over chain mail. A ledger hangs from her belt.
keeper.personality: Blunt, dry-humoured and practical; speaks in short clipped sentences.

ties.note: Took Tobin on as a favour to his late mother and quietly looks out for him.

mara.name: Tobin Reed
mara.motive: Prove himself useful to the captain without getting anyone hurt.
mara.appearance: A slight young halfling man with unruly sandy hair, freckles, a patched brown cloak, a sling at his hip and a wooden spoon tucked behind one ear.
mara.personality: Eager, talkative and a little nervous; jokes when frightened.

ties.note: Idolises the captain, who gave him his first real job.
